description: Defines the QuicSimpleServerSession class, a subclass of QuicServerSessionBase, representing a toy server-specific QUIC session with methods for stream creation, security, and WebTransport support.

classes.name: quic::QuicSimpleServerSession
classes.description: A subclass of QuicServerSessionBase implementing a toy server-specific QUIC session with custom stream creation and WebTransport support.

methods.name: QuicSimpleServerSession
methods.description: Constructor initializing the session with configuration, supported versions, connection, visitor, helper, crypto config, certs cache, and backend.

methods.name: OnStreamFrame
methods.description: Handles incoming stream frames, detecting client data on server push streams.

methods.name: CreateIncomingStream
methods.description: Creates an incoming QUIC stream given a stream ID or pending stream.

methods.name: CreateQuicCryptoServerStream
methods.description: Creates a QUIC crypto server stream.

methods.name: server_backend
methods.description: Returns the backend associated with this session.

methods.name: ShouldNegotiateWebTransport
methods.description: Determines if WebTransport should be negotiated based on backend support.

methods.name: LocalHttpDatagramSupport
methods.description: Returns local HTTP datagram support, considering WebTransport negotiation.
